captions.detailed: A magnifying floor lamp featuring a heavy, circular black base and a telescoping vertical support stand made of metallic grey cylindrical tubes. A black collar sits at the midpoint where the upper post telescopes out of the lower post. At the top, a horizontal hinge arm connects to a large, circular black housing that holds a semi-transparent glass magnifying lens. The telescoping post moves vertically, while the lens housing can rotate at the top joint and tilt along its horizontal axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an adjustable magnifying floor lamp. The lamp should feature a heavy circular base, a telescoping vertical pole consisting of nested cylindrical tubes with a central collar, and a circular magnifying lens housing at the top. Ensure it has a prismatic joint for the telescoping stand, a revolute joint at the top connector arm, and a tilting revolute joint for the lens ring itself.
captions.factory: Construct the floor lamp using an assembly of multiple parts. First, create the base part using a wide, flat cylinder and a small central collar cylinder. Second, build the lower vertical post as a long cylinder. Third, create the upper vertical post as a slightly thinner cylinder that translates along the Z-axis via a prismatic joint. Fourth, model the connector head at the top of the upper post using combined boxes and cylinders. Finally, construct the magnifying ring housing as a hollowed cylinder (using boolean subtraction) holding a thin glass-material cylinder inside, connected to the head via a revolute hinge joint.
